adjudication.rationale: In `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path now uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. When sharing mode is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), `parseRefreshTokenResponse` validates with `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, which does not explicitly include `expires_in`/`expiry_date` and (without `.passthrough()`) will strip unknown fields from the parsed output. Since the caller then does `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, any expiry-related fields returned by the sync endpoint can be dropped and therefore not persisted into `o365AuthCredentials`, plausibly leaving it expired and causing repeated refresh attempts.
